highlights.description: A security release: navigation and redirects check their URLs, the API client keeps requests under `baseUrl` and drops cached data when the person or organization changes, and telemetry sends less personal data by default

Packages: `@plexusone/api-client`, `auth`, `chat`, `pages`, `shell`, `telemetry` and `tenant` 0.3.0, `console` 0.2.0, `host` 0.5.0, `invites` 0.1.1 and `speech` 0.2.1; `design-tokens` and `ui` are unchanged

breaking.description: `ApiClient` appends a request path to `baseUrl` instead of resolving it, so `/users` under `https://app.example.com/api` is `.../api/users`; a path with a scheme, host, backslash, control character or dot segment throws `TypeError`, and a relative `baseUrl` such as `/api` now works
`ProtectedRoute` roles and `usePermissions().hasRole` are checked in the organization `orgId` names, or the person's only membership; a person with several memberships and no `orgId` is refused
`AuthProvider.logout` keeps the person signed in and sets `error` when the server does not end the session, instead of showing them signed out
`LoginPage` follows `redirectUrl` only when it is on this site, and goes to `/` otherwise
`UserSettingsPage`'s profile tab is read-only unless `onSaveProfile` is given; Change avatar shows only with `onChangeAvatar`

Telemetry page views no longer send `document.title` or the referrer unless `collectTitle` or `collectReferrer` is set, and never a query string; clicks are named by `data-track`, `aria-label` or `id`, not element text; requests use `credentials: 'same-origin'` unless `credentials` says otherwise; the ProductGraph anonymous ID is kept in memory unless `persistAnonymousId` is set
`ChatComposer` focuses only with `autoFocus`; `ChatThread` takes `composer={false}` to leave out its own composer, which `ChatWidget` and `ChatEmbed` now do
`withConnection` returns `undefined` for a return address that is not http(s) or that would leave the site once rebuilt

upgradeGuide.description: Install the new versions together: the packages that depend on `@plexusone/auth` need 0.3.0
Remove any `baseUrl` prefix you repeated in request paths, such as `/api/users` under `baseUrl: '/api'`, and encode IDs in paths with `encodeURIComponent`
Pass `orgId` to `ProtectedRoute` and `hasRole` for role checks, or use `RequireRole` from `@plexusone/tenant`
Pass `onSaveProfile` to `UserSettingsPage` to keep the profile editable

Set `collectTitle`, `collectReferrer`, `credentials: 'include'` or `persistAnonymousId` (with consent) only if you need them; send ProductGraph events through a same-origin route that adds the API key
Run SystemForge v0.31.0 or later on the server: the org pages show admin controls only to owners, as that release enforces

added.description: `safeHref`, `sameOriginURL`, `returnPath`, `currentPath` and `navigateTo` in `@plexusone/auth`, for URLs that reach `window.location` or an `href` outside React
`PRINCIPAL_CHANGE_EVENT` and `usePrincipalChange` in `@plexusone/auth`: `AuthProvider` and `SessionProvider` announce sign-out, session end and account switches
`hasRoleIn` and the `orgId` prop of `ProtectedRoute` in `@plexusone/auth`
`followTenant` on `ApiProvider`, default true: the client sends the organization `@plexusone/tenant` selects

`scrubUrl`, `scrubText` and `scrubOrigin` in `@plexusone/telemetry`, and the `collectTitle`, `collectReferrer`, `collectStacks` and `credentials` options; `serialize` on `useStateTracker`; `persistAnonymousId` and `credentials` on `ProductGraphAdapter`
`onSaveProfile` and `onChangeAvatar` on `UserSettingsPage`

security.description: The console's return address could leave the site: `withConnection` rebuilt an allowed `/.//host/x` from its path as `//host/x`

The product switcher, sidebar, breadcrumbs, menus and error and login pages could follow a `javascript:` URL: assigning an anchor's `href` or calling `location.assign` bypasses React's check. App catalog entries that are not http(s) are dropped
`ApiClient` sent a request, its headers and body to another origin when a path named one
Cached API data outlived a sign-out, an account switch or an organization change, and could be shown to the next person or in the next organization
A closed `ChatWidget` kept a focused composer mounted, so text typed elsewhere on the page could be sent as a chat message

Telemetry sent full referrers (which can carry invite or reset tokens), page titles, unscrubbed error messages and stacks and element text, sent cookies to its endpoint, and kept a device ID before consent; `sampleRate: 0` still sent every event

Sign-in `return_to`, request paths built from IDs, and bodyless state-changing requests are hardened: return addresses must be a path on this site, IDs are encoded, and console, invites and sign-out requests carry `X-Requested-With` so they are preflighted cross-origin
`ProtectedRoute` passed a role held in any organization; org pages acted on the previous organization after a switch; `logout` reported success when the server kept the session
Published source maps no longer name the build machine's paths, and the build fails if `dist` does; the release workflow pins actions by commit, grants least privilege and publishes with provenance

fixed.description: The chat stream parser kept no buffer between reads, so text split across network chunks was lost; non-streamed replies are read, and `onMessageSent`, `onMessageReceived`, `onOpen` and `onClose` fire
`ErrorBoundary` reports through the enclosing `TelemetryProvider`, and `DefaultErrorFallback` shows the message only in development
`TenantProvider` forgot the stored organization on every load and crashed when storage is blocked
The profile tab reported a save that never happened
Console help links with a malformed URL no longer break the page

`useConversations` applies only the latest load: a refresh still in flight when the API base changes no longer overwrites the new base's list, and a new base shows loading and no earlier error until its own load settles

`SessionProvider` and `useConversations` set state only when a load started in an effect settles, and only while mounted; `SessionProvider` updates `onUnauthorized` in a layout effect, so a session read settling right after a render calls the current callback
